linkedin_post.description: Max 120 words. Hook sentence, three takeaways each on its own line starting with '- ', then one closing question. No URLs.

newsletter_blurb.description: Max 60 words. One short paragraph. No URLs.

one_pager_md.description: Markdown: '# headline', '## What happened', '## Who is affected', '## 3 actions for compliance teams' (numbered list of three). No URLs.

relevance_score.description: 0-10. Importance for compliance teams at banks and fintechs.

relevance_reason.description: One sentence, max 30 words, explaining the score.
